from itertools import permutations

# Let me use a SAT/constraint solver approach
# x[0..13] is a permutation of 0..13
# d[i] = |x[i+1] - x[i]| for i in 0..12
# d[0..12] must be a permutation of 1..13

# Fixed constraints:
# x[6] = 3, x[12] = 6
# d[3] = 10, d[11] = 2

# Let's use python-constraint or backtracking
# Try with OR-Tools CP-SAT

from ortools.sat.python import cp_model

model = cp_model.CpModel()

N = 14

# Variables
x = [model.NewIntVar(0, N-1, f'x{i}') for i in range(N)]
d = [model.NewIntVar(1, N-1, f'd{i}') for i in range(N-1)]

# x is a permutation of 0..13
model.AddAllDifferent(x)

# d is a permutation of 1..13
model.AddAllDifferent(d)

# d[i] = |x[i+1] - x[i]|
for i in range(N-1):
    diff = model.NewIntVar(-(N-1), N-1, f'diff{i}')
    model.Add(diff == x[i+1] - x[i])
    model.AddAbsEquality(d[i], diff)

# Fixed assignments
model.Add(x[6] == 3)
model.Add(x[12] == 6)
model.Add(d[3] == 10)
model.Add(d[11] == 2)

# Solve
solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 30.0

status = solver.Solve(model)

if status == cp_model.FEASIBLE or status == cp_model.OPTIMAL:
    x_vals = [solver.Value(x[i]) for i in range(N)]
    d_vals = [solver.Value(d[i]) for i in range(N-1)]
    print("Solution found!")
    print("x =", x_vals)
    print("d =", d_vals)
    
    # Verify
    print("\nVerification:")
    print("x is permutation of 0-13:", sorted(x_vals) == list(range(14)))
    computed_d = [abs(x_vals[i+1] - x_vals[i]) for i in range(13)]
    print("computed d =", computed_d)
    print("d is permutation of 1-13:", sorted(computed_d) == list(range(1, 14)))
    print("x[6]=3:", x_vals[6] == 3)
    print("x[12]=6:", x_vals[12] == 6)
    print("d[3]=10:", computed_d[3] == 10)
    print("d[11]=2:", computed_d[11] == 2)
else:
    print("No solution found, status:", status)

result = [0, 13, 1, 12, 2, 11, 3, 10, 4, 9, 5, 8, 6, 7]
d_vals = [abs(result[i+1] - result[i]) for i in range(13)]

print("All-Interval Series of size 14:")
print("x =", result)
print()
print("Consecutive differences:")
for i in range(13):
    print(f"  |x[{i+1}] - x[{i}]| = |{result[i+1]} - {result[i]}| = {d_vals[i]}")
print()
print("Constraints satisfied:")
print(f"  x[6] = {result[6]} (required: 3) ✓" if result[6]==3 else "FAIL")
print(f"  x[12] = {result[12]} (required: 6) ✓" if result[12]==6 else "FAIL")
print(f"  d[3] = {d_vals[3]} (required: 10) ✓" if d_vals[3]==10 else "FAIL")
print(f"  d[11] = {d_vals[11]} (required: 2) ✓" if d_vals[11]==2 else "FAIL")
print(f"  x is permutation of 0-13: {sorted(result) == list(range(14))} ✓")
print(f"  d is permutation of 1-13: {sorted(d_vals) == list(range(1,14))} ✓")
